error:
TimeoutExpired(['bash', '-lc', 'set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
echo '===ARCH==='
arch=$(uname -m)
case "$arch" in
  x86_64) nodearch=x64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) nodearch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo "UNSUPPORTED_ARCH=$arch"; exit 44 ;;
esac
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.local/opt"
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '===USERSPACE_NODE24_INSTALL==='
  base=https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x
  tmp=$(mktemp -d)
  trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
  cd "$tmp"
  curl -fsSLO "$base/SHASUMS256.txt"
  tarball=$(awk -v a="linux-$nodearch.tar.xz" '$2 ~ a"$" {print $2; exit}' SHASUMS256.txt)
  [ -n "$tarball" ]
  curl -fsSLO "$base/$tarball"
  grep "  $tarball$" SHASUMS256.txt | sha256sum -c -
  rm -rf "$HOME/.local/opt/node-v24"
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/opt/node-v24"
  tar -xJf "$tarball" -C "$HOME/.local/opt/node-v24" --strip-components=1
  ln -sf "$HOME/.local/opt/node-v24/bin/node" "$HOME/.local/bin/node"
  ln -sf "$HOME/.local/opt/node-v24/bin/npm" "$HOME/.local/bin/npm"
  ln -sf "$HOME/.local/opt/node-v24/bin/npx" "$HOME/.local/bin/npx"
fi
echo '===NODE_FINAL==='
node -v
npm -v
major=$(node -p "parseInt(process.versions.node.split('.')[0])")
[ "$major" -ge 18 ]
echo '===ONCHAIN_INSTALL==='
npx -y @okxweb3/onchainos-installer install
echo '===POST_INSTALL==='
(command -v onchainos || true)
(onchainos --version || true)
echo '===OKX_FILES==='
find "$HOME" -maxdepth 7 \( -iname '*onchainos*' -o -iname '*okx*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -160
'], 900)
